comparison_rules: same brand + line + variant tokens; a different strength/formulation/model/set/kit is never compared
ml, g and count are compared only within the same dimension; bare 'oz' is ambiguous and only matches itself
pack total and unit size are kept separate; per-unit price is the common metric
a verified claim needs total volume within the config tolerance (default 5%) in the same base unit; other sizes are provisional like-basis only
SerpApi aggregates give a reference price basis only (0.95 x median) and never a competitive-minimum claim or score points
stale or unverified sources are reference_only and never scored

verified price advantage requires: live own price WITH a parseable observation timestamp no older than the config live freshness (default 24h, never future, never date-only), verified fresh market source, known market shipping and known own shipping
draft payload and model-recommended prices are never verified

parameters.priority_formula: 0.6*shopify_score + verified_price_points (20 + min(20, 0.8*gap_pct) only for verified_below); rank orders by original grade first

shopify_products_json.reason: category-level placeholder rows with a flat price and no pd_no

unknowns: No market item records shipping, so no delivered comparison exists; comparisons are at best provisional.
Our customer-facing shipping charge is not in any input; pass --own-shipping-usd to evaluate delivered price.
No product-level orders/traffic input; all review metrics are UNKNOWN (not zero).
Supplemental Shopify transaction and Managed Markets fees are UNKNOWN, not assumed zero or added; modeled margins are not full verified profit.
7 products have a landed-cost scenario in pricing_model.json; all others have no margin beyond an upper bound.

s_preservation.note: Grades come only from the original S gate (qualify_s). A price advantage never upgrades a product.

skincare.strategy_note: skincare: 5 S, 47 A; 2 with an own live/draft price; 0 with a verified price position; 2 non-beauty misfit(s) excluded from ranking. Price advantage is not claimed where unverified.

evidence_required: Daiso detail page / gosi volume text per pd_no
unit weight in grams (measured) for landed-cost accuracy

evidence_required: shipping cost or free-shipping statement to US

evidence_required: live Shopify price + shipping rate table

reviewer name and date once reviewed

review_24h.missing_metric_policy: a metric that is absent, null, negative or non-numeric is reported as the string "UNKNOWN", never as 0
review_24h.causality_policy: A 24h before/after view cannot show that a price change caused any order or traffic change. Report observations only; do not promise sales effects.
read_plan: T0: record exact timestamp, price in force, and live/draft state of each listing
T+24h: read product-level sessions, product views, add-to-cart, orders, units for the same window
Report each metric as observed or UNKNOWN; flag any concurrent ad/promo/stock change as a confounder

explicit confirmation that no other price/promo/ad change happened in the window, or a list of what changed
